role: The one-shot static registration the game runs before anything else: func_151354_b registers every block, item, potion effect, enchantment, stat and sound, and func_151353_a fills BlockDispenser's behavior registry.

members.name: func_151353_a
members.note: the dispenser behavior registry: dispensers never dispense (world.conf redstone = off) and the boat and firework behaviors are switched-off features, so the whole registry is unreachable; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: func_151354_b
members.note: the block and item registrations are the generated BLOCKS/ITEMS tables; potions, enchantments, stats and sounds are only covered where each system's port reads them (for example the achievement table in survival.c), not verified object by object

members.name: Bootstrap
members.note: a holder of static members: oracle/src has no `new Bootstrap(` anywhere, so the implicit ctor never runs

members.name: Bootstrap$1.getProjectileEntity
members.note: the behavior for arrows; a dispenser behavior (Bootstrap.func_151353_a registers it): it runs only from BlockDispenser.func_149941_e, reached from updateTick, which onNeighborBlockChange schedules only while isBlockIndirectlyGettingPowered; with world.conf redstone = off World.getIndirectPowerLevelTo and isBlockProvidingPowerTo return 0, so no dispenser ever fires

notes: The registries themselves are generated from the oracle (make -C oracle blocks-h / items-h), so the registration ordering and values come from the live Java objects rather than a re-reading of this file. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): reachable only through a world.conf switch that is off (the dispenser registry, redstone). Formerly listed as missing: func_151353_a: the dispenser behavior registry has no native counterpart and is unreachable in this game. The stats, sounds and potion-effect registrations of func_151354_b are not individually verified against the native tables.
